name: Ambassador Faelin
guide_text: Very often the curve on this hero is to level to tavern 3 on turn 4 and level to 4 on turn 5 so you can unlock your 4 drop as soon as possible. The best 4 drops to pick are the ones that generate value every turn such as [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]].
buddy_guide_text: Keep a look out for [[Rylak Metalhead]] or [[Greenskeeper]] which are the best cards with this buddy, because repeatedly proccing its battlecry is very useful. Then you may scale with Mooneater + Brann. Usually you buddy up when it costs 3, but if you have Rylak or Greenskeeper, buddy up as soon as possible.
